### Brief death / astral fever-dream lock
Arthur truly dies briefly. His soul/consciousness astral-projects while remaining tethered to his body by a **silver cord**. The cord is not externally perceivable/interactable/severable by other actors. Arthur does not consciously understand the astral state and gains no repeatable astral-projection ability afterward.

Subjectively, the death threshold becomes a vivid Far-Cry-3-style fever dream in which Dutch and the Van der Linde gang appear to wake/help Arthur, then silently lead him through reality that stretches, melts, replaces locations and behaves with dream logic. Dutch acts disturbingly gentle/out-of-character. Arthur asks if Dutch is okay and receives no normal response. Eventually Arthur realizes everybody is gone. From directly behind him Dutch says exactly: **"I… am truly sorry, son."** Arthur snaps around — **WHITE** — and physically wakes.

The deeper cause/nature of the vision remains UNKNOWN. Much later Cyber-Arthur experiences the sequence again **frame-for-frame through the WHITE**, but this second occurrence continues beyond the original cutoff. ## S35 Billy — permanent serum evolution (committed design; future/unearned)

Successful administration of **VIOLET ASCENDANCY SERUM to Chris** also permanently evolves Billy. Chris has **no idea** beforehand that the serum will affect Billy; this is not his planned upgrade or a secretly known project goal. The author's committed design is not actor knowledge. The first post-serum exterior Billy manifestation reveals the change; no mandatory separate transformation mode or repeat evolution. Switching back to Chris does not undo Billy's evolved baseline. The one-exterior-body bond, independent agencies, Billy-controlled return, persistent BELLY and no damage-reset rule remain. Chris's human improvements and firearms-execution payoff retain their own meaningful use; no automatic Billy takeover when combat begins.

### Physical and sensory results
- **10'6" / 1,700 lb**, retaining broad swamp-brute proportions; **5×** pre-serum lifting, gripping and biting force; **3×** movement speed and reaction rate (reaction latency one-third); hide, bones and tissues have **10×** pre-serum resistance to injury from comparable physical attacks. These are total post-serum ratios against the pre-serum baseline, not recursively stacking bonuses. Existing zero-drag water-swimming and physical propulsion remain.
- Regrows limbs and organs, including severe bodily damage. A completely lost arm takes **10 minutes without feeding**. Regeneration works independently; digesting enough food or organic matter accelerates its rate **3×**, so the same arm takes **3 minutes 20 seconds** if boosted throughout. Partial feeding accelerates only the boosted interval. Swallowing/preserving occupants or storing terrain and inorganic objects does not count as organic digestion. Other injury-specific timings and simultaneous-regrowth allocation are not numerically specified.
- Sharper detail/motion/low-light sight, individual scent/taste trails and substance discrimination, ground/water vibration sensing and selective hearing. Automatic filtering plus deliberate focus; ordinary enhanced senses require actual available signals. Bayou-wide person-position sensing is its separate explicit supernatural exception.
- Longer, faster tongue with stronger grip and fine control for precision grabs/disarming; reinforced cutting/gripping teeth. Billy **already swallows prey, terrain and objects regardless of size**, subject to legitimate access/resistance. Wider gape dramatizes existing whole-head enlargement; it does not newly unlock a size ceiling.
- **Camouflage**, not automatic perfect invisibility: covers body, clothing and anything deliberately held; blends best when still or slowly stalking, rapid movement makes him easier to spot. Both intentional activation and automatic danger response. It does not itself erase sound, scent, pressure traces or guarantee escape from detection; no newly chosen numeric range or duration. Existing colors remain under camouflage, with darker ridges and thick hide patches.

### Catfish, alligator and megalodon-influenced anatomy
Catfish identity stays recognizable: six independently restless sensory barbels, deep-set heavy-lidded eyes under a massive ridged brow, thick jaw folds hiding overlapping teeth until opening, deeper slowly flaring gills, heavy neck and broad body. Resting jaw stays closed; yellow-gold eyes, hat aperture, separate Scout compass badge, pouch, exact banjo inscription and green blood persist. No generic shark head or compulsory long alligator snout.

Pronounced ridges at brow/jaw, shoulders/spine, forearms/knuckles and tail. Raised armored scutes along shoulders, spine and tail; a thick muscular tail flattened sideways for swimming; protective inner eyelids sliding across the eyes underwater. Wet leathery folds between rough scutes, old scars interrupting camouflage, mottles resembling submerged bark/mud/shadow and deep joint creases unfolding in motion.

Larger front cutting teeth and smaller inward gripping rows form an interlocking jagged edge. Replacement teeth continuously develop behind damaged/lost teeth. Biology permits a closing throat valve, expandable capture-stage throat pouch, dexterous hooking anchoring claws, retractable hand/foot webbing, jaw pressure-sensing pits, protective gum/cheek folds, defensive clear slime, independent tongue-tip lure, angled gripping throat teeth and a bellow sac. Dormant-looking posture retains alert awareness; sediment burial supports concealment. None of these details supplies unselected poison, sonic damage or mind control.

### Controlled hunting and grotesque presentation
Available attacks: bite-and-wrench, sustained crushing clamp, momentum-driven swimming bite, repeated release/reposition bites, clamping whole-body death roll, drowning drag, waterline/upward ambush, collision attack and tail sweep. Actual contact, force, target durability, leverage and surroundings govern results; influence does not guarantee dismemberment or a hit.

Instincts strengthen ambush, isolation, relentless physical-clue pursuit, escape interception and playing with prey, all under Billy's control. Long stillness can break into an explosive lunge; stalking crouch uses tail balance; huge mass passes through mud/water with barely a ripple; head slowly turns before the body. Surface watching, submerged stalking, patient circling, attacks from below, blood-trail pursuit and deceptively sleepy attention fit his existing intelligence. A faint wake may disappear as he submerges; concealment does not erase every physical clue.

Horror details are situational, not a checklist: driftwood-like stillness; barbels touching before the bite; clinging swamp debris; eye-shine behind clouded protective eyelids; open mouth mistaken for a hollow beneath roots; a low bellow felt through contact; a patient touch before a grab; an unseen polite conversation followed by an unhurried return to its interrupted topic. Deep chest-heavy bellows carry over water, wet growls underlie ordinary speech, gills flutter and throat clicks investigate prey; silence may precede an explosive snarl.

Grotesque body detail remains bodily: teeth bulge/rotate beneath gums and old teeth are spat out; sequential gripping throat folds move during intake; crown, cheeks, jaw and neck enlarge in stages; the capture-stage throat pouch can show movement before passage. Scutes lift over wet healing seams; exposed gill tissue shows green vessels; regenerating limbs appear beneath membrane, fingers separate and claws emerge; uneven smile folds, independently probing barbels during restful stillness, slime-sheet shedding, casual self-maintenance and mud expelled from temporary healing pores can be shown. Billy cannot lose consciousness. Already routed/preserved BELLY occupants do not become exterior moving bulges or digestion fuel by implication. Green blood is not acidic/toxic by color.

The serum amplifies existing demonic hospitality, patience, appetites and cultivation of dependence as defined in the current personality owner. It does not overwrite his humor, sincerity, petty concerns, affection, stupidity or chosen restraint. Music and welcome through fog remain favored dramatic tools; reveal and intensity vary with context.

### Exterior swimmable bayou overlay — future serum ability

This unnamed ability creates a **supernatural bayou overlay on land without excavating underlying space**. It is distinct from BELLY OF THE BILLY, its internal CATFISH BAYOU development and MY NAME IS MUD's six-foot grave. Exterior immersion never automatically swallows a person, adds prison custody or opens a route into the stomach.

- A fully spread circle has **500-meter radius / 1-kilometer diameter**. Maximum total footprint is **250,000π square meters (about 785,398 m²)**. The connected shape may stretch up to **5 kilometers between its farthest points** while respecting that same area budget; these are simultaneous area and diameter constraints, not a five-kilometer radius.
- Spreads outward to maximum size in **10 seconds**. Deepest channels/ambush pools reach **100 meters** of supernatural depth. Deep murky channels, ambush pools, sucking mud, unstable banks, firm ground, cypress-like trees, exposed roots, hanging moss, low fog, floating vegetation and dense reeds are available. Billy can reshape channels/pools/mud/firm ground while active. No separate animated-root attack or current-control power is selected.
- Billy chooses whether to anchor the overlay or have it follow him. If it moves away from submerged people, their occupied sections remain anchored and connected until they leave; the rest follows Billy. Connecting corridors and occupied sections count against the footprint and five-kilometer span. Following expansion cannot violate either cap: it must stop/reallocate unoccupied area or await release/exit rather than sever or silently erase an occupied section. Full control and person-position sensing remain throughout connected sections.
- **Selective submersion:** Billy chooses who can enter the depths. Selected people's footing immediately becomes water, with falling/swimming/physical escape then resolving normally; unselected people meet solid ground. This is not automatic immobilization or instant drowning. Existing buildings remain visible above; Billy can swim beneath their footprints and emerge through selected floors. No automatic collapse, excavation or wholesale building erasure.
- Billy senses **every person's position throughout the overlay**, including its connected anchored portions. This does not disclose thoughts, intentions, identity or weaknesses. Broader object omniscience is not granted.
- A submerged target can return through openings Billy leaves accessible. Other surface exits require breaching the barrier: **attacks that could breach Billy's evolved hide can breach it**. No automatic unbreakability, regeneration of the barrier or stronger threshold is implied. Bayou escape uses this rule, not BELLY's separate permission-only egress.
- Remains until **Billy dismisses it or switches to Chris**. Billy cannot die or lose consciousness; those are not shutdown triggers. On closure, people and objects still underwater **rise to corresponding surface positions as the depths recede**. Closure is not a crushing/burying/telefrag mechanic. Actual prior injuries, losses, environmental consequences and acquired knowledge persist; closure does not undo them.

No formal ability name, new cooldown, mandatory announcement, added resource tax, fixed reshape/closure speed or numeric held-object camouflage cap has been selected. These unknowns cannot be silently turned into extra powers or convenient constraints. No serum benefit is available before successful administration.

RESEARCH FINDINGS: WHAT MAKES VAAS DISTINCTIVE

A. Deliberate social performance and genuine emotional volatility coexist.
The Ubisoft-assisted Prima guide describes Vaas presenting himself as reasonable to intensify the later rage. Separately, cinematics director Robert Darryl Purdy describes uncontrolled changes from softness to anger. Producer Dan Hay's interview emphasizes purpose and real emotional investment. The combined reading supports different causes for different moments: pretended patience, sincere temporary engagement, genuine offense, and anger that becomes useful for coercion. It does not establish that every switch is planned, or that he cannot pursue an objective. [V1, V2, V3]

B. His intimidation is immediate and relational.
Lead designer Jamie Kean identifies proximity and uncertain next action as central to the effect. The threat is strongest when the target can recognize Vaas's real power over their present situation. This supports attention, closeness and control of the interaction as performance principles. It does not establish that every actor is automatically frightened, that every target is helpless, or that Vaas has perfect psychological perception. [V4]

C. The accessible primary game excerpt contains specific conversational moves.
Ubisoft's official podcast transcript reproduces part of the definition-of-insanity scene. Its structure moves from a conversational invitation into an explanation, repetitive emphasis, an anecdote of violence, a concession that the victim was right, and an abrupt accusation concerning the listener's gaze. An apparent apology introduces hostility. The target's response becomes more urgent to Vaas than the proposition he was explaining. This is close reading of that excerpt; it is not a statistical inventory of every scene or a verified account of the excerpt's exact audio timing. [V5]

D. Speech and physical performance were created together.
Mando reports simultaneous body, face and voice performance, in-character development exercises with Brent George, and freedom in dialogue and blocking. The production record favors expressive behavior arising from the same immediate thought as the spoken line. The official podcast also records Mando's account of improvising a turn while pouring gasoline. These are firsthand production reports; they are not a claim that this research watched or measured that choreography. [V5, V6, V7]

E. Personal investment changes his treatment of a particular opponent.
The guide traces Jason's significance from a profitable captive to an escaped rival threatening Vaas's operation. Ubisoft's official profile also emphasizes Vaas's interest in pushing Jason. His fixation therefore has a history and a particular object. A person can matter to him for practical, emotional and recreational reasons at once. [V1, V8]

F. Emotional depth does not imply moral rescue.
Mando describes putting heartbreak and emotional confusion into the performance. That is a statement about the actor's method, not proof that Vaas has the actor's biography. Prima acknowledges traces of humanity while retaining Vaas's cruelty. The later DLC explicitly expands his interior range. The defensible application is that a dangerous person can have real hurt, need, amusement, humiliation and attachment without any of those feelings automatically excusing or reversing chosen harm. [V1, V7, V9]

G. The design trusted performance to carry the danger.
Prima documents the concept progression from Bull through Pyro to Vaas. With Mando, the team reduced overt visual signals and used a subtler presentation. This supports restraint in redundant narrative cues: a scene need not describe every smile as sinister or every movement as unhinged. The particular costume, bandages and grooming remain Vaas design details, not additional Kaze specifications. [V1]

H. The versions have different evidence scopes.
Far Cry 3 supplies the main outward performance reference. The Far Cry Experience is a separate promotional live-action performance: Mando retrospectively describes finding more comedy and childlike play there. Far Cry 6: Vaas: Insanity expands the interior portrayal; Ubisoft places it inside Vaas's mind after his confrontation with Jason and identifies memories as ghostly reenactments. Mando's discussion of playing vulnerable and predatory versions of himself is DLC-specific. These sources can inform interpretation without importing dream events, repeated deaths, private habits, family history or game mechanics into Kaze. [V5, V9, V10]

PROPOSED KAZE IMPLEMENTATION — ORIGINAL APPLICATION OF THE RESEARCH

1. The performance follows a live purpose.
Before the exchange, identify what Kaze presently wants from this particular person: an answer, a reaction, room to act, recognition, amusement, submission in a specific dispute, information, or an end to the encounter. Let that purpose change only when his real perceptions or priorities change. His actual thoughts can remain contradictory. A strong purpose does not require composure, and a burst of emotion does not erase the purpose.

2. Separate stated subject, interpersonal demand and emotional stake.
Kaze can appear to discuss a practical matter while caring more about whether somebody thinks they can deceive, dismiss, control or humiliate him. The pressure can move from the practical question to the response he is receiving. Establish that turn through what happens in the exchange. His interpretation can be mistaken, unfair or knowingly opportunistic; it is not narrator-certified truth.

3. Keep his speech alive in the moment.
Use existing live-thought construction: unfinished starts, self-repair, repeated fragments, a corrected premise, a briefly pursued comparison and a precise landing. Each has a purpose. Repeating a word can expose fixation; correcting it can sharpen an accusation; restarting can show that an apparently small detail has become the real issue. Do not add a false start to every sentence or impose a recurring verbal signature on every scene.

4. Change the function of a sentence, not only the volume.
A question can begin as information-seeking and become a challenge. An explanation can become an indictment. A joke can become a demand for participation. Apparent reassurance can define conditions that leave the other person less room. These are possible interaction choices, not a compulsory sequence. The listener's answer, silence, interruption or refusal must be able to affect what Kaze does next.

5. Preserve multiple meanings of calmness.
Kaze may be sincerely relaxed, temporarily engaged, pretending patience, controlling an urge, amused by the situation or already resolved. The scene should know which interpretation is supported, or preserve a real ambiguity. A soft register need not signal safety; it also need not announce an inevitable shout. Sometimes he remains calm. Sometimes he interrupts himself. Sometimes he acts before explaining.

6. Allow deliberate provocation and sincere escalation in the same encounter.
He can begin by baiting somebody, discover that their response irritates him more than expected, then use that irritation to press harder. He can also enter angry and become amused, interested or briefly distracted. Do not retrofit flawless calculation to every decision. Conversely, do not use unpredictability to erase his established intelligence or ability to pursue a result.

7. Make physical behavior express the same thought as the words.
Use the body and environment Kaze actually has. Available details include his existing loose movement, hands occupied with a real object, a change of distance, altered attention, a held look, an interrupted gesture, stillness or sudden movement. Choose a detail because it changes the exchange. Proximity requires real access; an opponent may move, interrupt, resist or act. A meaningful gesture is more useful than a repeated inventory of predatory smiles, head tilts and clenched fists.

8. Expand the danger range without a compulsory ladder.
The existing movement-toward-silence pattern remains a recognizable possibility. The new direction also permits dangerous animation, humor, restless movement, abrupt volume changes and hostile playfulness. Kaze need not pass through every older escalation stage. Familiar people may recognize a known silence while still understanding that laughter is not a guarantee of restraint. Ordinary silence outside that context remains ordinary silence.

Proposed local clarification to the existing serious-vocal, major-danger-tell and physical-escalation headings: treat their documented progression as one contextual route, not a universal requirement. This is a targeted portrayal change; it creates no new form, power, hidden persona or automatic mood cycle.

9. Let fixation be earned by specific encounters.
Kaze can take unusual interest in somebody who surprises him, refuses a frame he expected them to accept, shows unexpected nerve, exposes a contradiction he cannot dismiss, threatens a valued relationship, or remains useful in an interesting way. A minor opponent does not automatically become a new Jason-equivalent obsession. Preserve what he already knows and what the encounter actually adds.

10. Keep the speech recognizably Kaze's.
His informal vocabulary, Chicago-rooted roast register, contextual profanity, messy construction and precise distinctions remain the language through which this added behavior operates. The request supports Vaas-derived timing, conversational pressure and behavioral volatility. It has not separately selected a nationality change, a phonetic accent imitation, Michael Mando's exact vocal identity or habitual transplanted address words. Exact pitch, rasp, breath patterns, vowel placement and pause lengths remain unverified by this research.

11. Keep the target's agency and the world's consequences.
Intimidation is evaluated through the other person's knowledge, temperament, situation and available responses. Kaze's ordinary presence is not an automatic fear power. Existing supernatural fear abilities continue to use their actual owners and triggers. A threat can cause compliance, resistance, confusion, resentment, flight, strategic concealment or a mixture. Fear is not automatically trust, loyalty or truthful testimony.

12. Use Kaze's actual relationship rules.
His existing affection, protectiveness, bad faith, enjoyment of fear, irritation and relationship-specific permissions can all operate. He may unsettle or confront an ally where his established profile supports that, and allies retain their ability to challenge him. The Seven Sins' chosen bonds are not rewritten into Vaas's command structure. Kaze's absolute restraint toward Frank remains controlling. Romance stays OFF. Source research adds no new diagnosis, childhood, family history, addiction, private ritual or hidden emotional truth to Kaze.

13. Let capability and purpose determine duration.
A personally meaningful or useful exchange may hold him; a decisive combat solution does not wait for a speech merely to display the influence. A change of method can be abrupt while still using the actual kit. No weaker attack, missed opening, repeated release or artificial escape is created to reproduce Far Cry's mission structure. A target's continued survival must follow legitimate circumstances or Kaze's real choice.

14. Render the influence through ordinary Black Mimir narration.
Mimir supplies the relevant physical cue and consequence in connected prose. Do not name a Vaas mode, describe a checklist in PLAY, or repeatedly assure the audience that Kaze is unpredictable. At most, make the significant transition legible: what captured his attention, what changed in the exchange and what the other person now does. Unwritten performance has not been certified by this document.

FUTURE PORTRAYAL REVIEW QUESTIONS
- What does Kaze want from this specific person now?
- Which actual response changes his attention or emotional stake?
- Is this composure sincere, strategic, strained or uncertain?
- Do speech and physical action express the same immediate thought?
- Is the listener still acting as an independent person with real options?
- Does the turn follow Kaze's established knowledge, kit, relationships and choices?
- Would the dialogue remain recognizable as Kaze without a copied catchphrase?
- Does the moment still work if the narrator stops labeling it frightening?

These are prospective qualitative review questions, not newly completed PLAY tests or behavioral quotas.

Likely integration owners upon later authorized cutover:
- canon/characters/kaze_psychology.md: speech, behavior, physical/vocal fidelity, contextual escalation and review questions.
- canon/characters/kaze_current.md: compact reference to the psychology owner.
- Relevant routing and derived projections only after canonical owner changes are settled.

Controlling user directions, including the newest correction:

CORRECTED WORKING PROPOSAL
Working hat species: Giganotosaurus carolinii.
Proposed age: approximately 110 million years, placing his birth in the Early Cretaceous.

Making Billy older is explicitly user-directed. The approximate 110-million-year number is the assistant's concrete recommendation, not a number the user supplied. Giganotosaurus is the prepared working species inferred from the user's repeated preference; this addendum does not misreport a separate final species-selection utterance. Neither is inserted into the committed s38 files during this staged pass.

The prior Tyrannosaurus recommendation based on fitting that age is withdrawn. The earlier Carnotaurus recommendation remains withdrawn. No further dinosaur shortlist is needed to proceed with this draft.

RESEARCHED TIMELINE AND FICTIONAL AGE
The Natural History Museum's Giganotosaurus entry gives a broad range of approximately 100–95 million years ago and reconstructs an enormous carnivore around 13 metres long. Its incompleteness prevents a precise universal size ranking. The International Commission on Stratigraphy's chart places 110 million years ago within the Early Cretaceous. Thus an approximately 110-million-year-old Billy would already have been alive for roughly 10–15 million years during the cited Giganotosaurus range. That subtraction is a consistency calculation for the proposed fictional biography. [D4, D8]

His established survival of the approximately 66-million-year-old extinction catastrophe remains. At the proposed age he would have been roughly 44 million years old then. This changes the birth-era wording as well as the age; it does not establish his location, exposure, injuries, exact survival method, or an additional immunity.

The proposed age places Billy before Giganotosaurus, but does not put every dinosaur species together in one prehistoric period. A deliberately ridiculous boast can mix details; objective narration should distinguish that from an established encounter. The Louisiana/bayou association, later astral bond with Chris, demonic/yordle ontology, mentor relationships and existing training remain. This update assigns no prehistoric migration itinerary or ancient dates to his later equipment, mentors, culture or Southern English.

PROPOSED MATERIAL WORDING
Catfish Billy's cowboy hat is made from Giganotosaurus leather, replacing the former alligator leather. It retains the established cowboy silhouette, dark weathered finish, Scout compass badge and separate orange front aperture. Its existing artifact functions and unexplained relic history continue under their current owners.

Giganotosaurus supplies the material's giant-predator identity. Actual fossil evidence does not rank hypothetical finished dinosaur leather. A specific scale pattern, horn trim, new enchantment, extra durability or fear effect is not selected here. The hat can serve as a prop in Billy's stories without authenticating a claimed hunt, maker, manufacturing date or individual animal's history. The latest current visual remains the s38 Billy PNG; no replacement image has been created.

PROPOSED AGE WORDING
Catfish Billy is approximately 110 million years old, born during the Early Cretaceous. He genuinely lived alongside non-avian dinosaurs and survived the extinction catastrophe approximately 66 million years ago. His prehistoric presence is factual within this fictional continuity; individual feats, rivalries and glory-days anecdotes require their own established evidence before narration treats them as fact.

3. USER-SELECTED CHANGE: BILLY'S DINOSAUR GLORY DAYS AND SOUTHERN SPEECH

User-selected direction: Billy tells dinosaur-era apex-predator stories with the energy of a drunk cookout uncle remembering his football prime and blaming a lost career on an injury, combined with Uncle Rico's glory-days fixation. Research and deepen authentic Southern hospitality speech while keeping Billy's existing speech fidelity.

The broad direction is selected. The particular behaviors, sample lines, invented nicknames and anecdotes below are brainstorm proposals. They establish no delivered scene, football career, old injury, specific kill, new acquaintance or obligatory joke.

EXISTING FOUNDATION TO KEEP
Billy already combines ornate Tahm-Kench-like verbal texture with backwoods vulgarity, food/river/bargain imagery, theatrical rhythm, predatory politeness, sincere hospitality, recreational lying, pettiness, affection, occasional real stupidity and hidden tactical intelligence. His real age and present danger give the stories weight. He can want recognition for past greatness while remaining formidable now. The cookout-uncle reference describes social behavior; it does not require intoxication, slurring or a decline in power.

UNCLE RICO RESEARCH
In a direct Q&A, Jon Gries characterizes Rico as self-involved and poor at reading the room. His earlier Mr. Media interview discusses the fixation on quarterback glory and filming throws. The useful adaptation is the appetite for recognition, the compulsion to demonstrate, and the grievance that circumstances prevented proper appreciation. The user supplied the cookout/ACL comparison. Billy's voice and actual biography remain his own. [R1, R2]

AUTHENTIC SOUTHERN TOOLS
Southern English has regional and social variation. The consulted scholarship covers broad Southern American English and particular North Carolina/Appalachian varieties. Use the overlapping features selectively; the evidence is not a license to combine every Texas, Appalachian, Cajun, Creole or other Southern feature into a single accent.

1. Y'all: an established Southern second-person form, especially useful for addressing the whole gathering. Billy may invite everyone into his audience without turning every sentence into a regional announcement. [S1]

2. Fixing to / fixin' to: expresses preparation or intent to act in the near future. Billy can use it for dinner, departure, warning or an imminent change of patience. It has grammatical work to do; it is not decorative filler. [S1]

3. Might could: expresses a tentative possibility and can soften a proposal or obligation. For Billy it supports gracious offers, teasing understatement and pressure delivered as apparent accommodation. It need not mean he is confused about his own ability. [S2]

4. Used to could: an attested combination for former ability. It fits a glory-days opening. In Billy's application, the lost condition may be the old competition, venue or opportunity; the wording by itself does not lower current strength. [S3]

5. Mighty, right and plumb: documented intensifiers. They supply occasional texture to ordinary sentences. They should not all appear together or become a required set of ticks. [S3]

6. Narrative present: a storyteller can move from past narration into a present-tense reenactment, bringing an old event closer to the audience. Billy can shift into describing the dinosaur's approach as though everyone should see it now. This device also occurs outside the South. [S3]

7. Bless your heart: research finds a range of positive and negative uses, including more nuance than the stereotype of a concealed insult. Billy can mean affection, concern, pity or contempt. Genuine hospitality should retain genuine language. [S4]

8. Sit a spell: an attested invitation to rest or visit for a while. A Southern Foodways account uses the expression in describing a Georgia family food business. For Billy, an invitation to sit can become the courteous beginning of an unsolicited long story. [S5]

9. All hat and no cattle: an attested Texas-associated criticism of display without substance. It is available as a deliberately chosen saying, especially around a conspicuous hat, but does not establish a Texas origin for Billy. [S6]

10. Full as a tick: an attested comparison for being very full, documented in a locally authored North Carolina source. It fits the appetite vocabulary. Treat more elaborate new variations as Billy's inventions, not historical proverbs. [S7]

SPEECH APPLICATION
Build the voice through social intention, sentence construction and concrete experience. Billy notices whether a guest has eaten, offers a place to sit, prolongs a visit, softens a request, evaluates manners, takes his time with a story, or becomes personally offended by a breach of hospitality. These can be sincere habits, predatory choices or self-indulgence, depending on the situation. Southern hospitality itself is not evidence of deceit.

His characteristic turn can move from an elaborate courteous setup to a short vulgar landing. He can also finish warmly, stay blunt throughout, or speak plainly when a practical matter deserves it. Elaborate metaphor is a resource rather than an obligation. Use food, river conditions, weather, hunting, livestock, household work, debts and favors when the comparison fits the observed situation and Billy's legitimate knowledge.

Keep accent spelling light and readable. Ordinary contractions and selected regional forms provide enough text guidance for this pass. No exact Louisiana subdialect or measured phonetic performance has been established. Newly coined comparisons must be labeled original examples rather than passed off as collected Southern sayings.

ORIGINAL VOICE CALIBRATIONS — NOT TRADITIONAL SAYINGS OR CANON EVENTS
- Sincere hospitality: "Come on in. You look like somebody's been feeding you excuses."
- Tentative offer: "I might could help. Depends how attached you are to doing it the respectable way."
- Warm irritation: "Sit down and eat, son. You can disappoint me on a full stomach."
- Polite pressure: "You're welcome to take your time. I do hope you spend some of it answering."
- Blunt landing: "That is a mighty elaborate explanation for shitting the bed."
- Glory-days opening: "I used to could judge a whole afternoon by which way the big ones were running."

BEHAVIOR BRAINSTORM — SELECTABLE IDEAS

A. The extinction spoiled his career.
He treats a prehistoric catastrophe as an administrative failure that interrupted his recognition. Keep the grievance absurdly personal. He may compare events across eras without claiming Giganotosaurus survived until the asteroid.
Sample: "Had a scout coming Tuesday. Sky fell Monday. Piss-poor scheduling."
The scout is a suggested boast or metaphor, not a new established prehistoric sports organization.

B. The ACL excuse survives every factual objection.
He borrows the shape of the injured-athlete grievance, even though a literal permanent knee injury is not established. If someone challenges the explanation, he becomes offended by the institution or principle instead.
Sample: "You can mend cartilage, son. You can't mend politics."
Do not give him an actual chronic injury or lost physical capacity merely to service the joke.

C. Apex predator was a management position.
He talks about enormous carnivores as junior employees who needed scheduling, supervision and basic table manners.
Sample: "Apex? Hell, I was the one approving their lunch breaks."
This is Billy's framing of old dominance; dinosaurs do not acquire human institutions or speech through the metaphor.

D. The cookout becomes compulsory film study.
An ordinary size comparison prompts him to move available tableware around as terrain and try to recruit someone to stand where the animal stood. The audience can refuse. He is annoyed that they want the conclusion without appreciating his footwork.
Sample: "Hold that plate level. You're the floodplain. This is why nobody learns nothing."
No props, volunteers or compliant audience are automatically created.

E. He corrects the tiniest detail in an enormous story.
He ignores the implausible central claim and argues about wind direction, the bank of a river or whose meal was interrupted. Precision becomes a way to defend his authority without proving the rest.
Sample: "West bank. If you're going to doubt me, have the courtesy to doubt the right damn riverbank."

F. The hat is his favorite exhibit.
He uses the brim and the material to imply that further questions are impertinent. Its species can be real while his explanation remains boast, evasion or unverified history.
Sample: "You're welcome to question my recollection. Do handle the evidence with clean hands."

G. Geology is tampering with his old statistics.
He points to a distant landmark as evidence of an old feat, then blames changing terrain when the measurement does not favor him.
Sample: "That ridge was farther then. Earth keeps moving my damn goalposts."
This is an original joke, not a geological explanation of a particular unestablished feat.

H. His competitors had embarrassing ordinary reputations.
He resents grand scientific names and reduces a terrifying animal to a petty nickname or alleged bad habit. Any named individual remains a proposed anecdote.
Sample: "Y'all put a fine name on him. I remember a loud bastard who couldn't wait his turn."
Do not turn every dinosaur into a talking human or make every boast objectively true.

I. He becomes an unsolicited predator coach.
A present threat's actual posture or noise can prompt expert criticism delivered like sideline advice. Sometimes the assessment is useful; sometimes he is being a vain nuisance.
Sample: "Fine set of teeth. He leads with his temper, though."
The other actor still decides what to do, and Billy's assessment may be wrong.

J. The missing scar is somehow another injustice.
He claims the body has healed away his best supporting evidence and complains that taking care of himself has hurt his reputation.
Sample: "I had a scar would've settled this. Healed. Now I got to explain myself like a civilian."
This supplies no permanent scar or established old injury.

K. He spends his legend's climax on a petty sensory complaint.
The audience expects a great victory; Billy is still offended by the meat, smell, mud or interruption to his dinner.
Sample: "Forty feet of bad attitude, and the meat still needed salt."
Taste remains subjective, not biological analysis or confirmation of a specific eaten specimen.

L. Occasionally the real old knowledge lands quietly.
An apparently ridiculous recollection contains a correct practical observation about movement, footing or appetite. He may act on it when his existing knowledge and current evidence support the choice, then return to ordinary hospitality. An impressive payoff is optional; small accuracy can make the surrounding exaggeration funnier.
Sample: "There. See that? He ain't committed yet. Quit giving him room to think."

RECOMMENDED EMPHASIS
The strongest initial combination is the career grievance, hat-as-exhibit, unsolicited demonstrations, petty factual corrections and occasional useful expertise. Rotate motives and topics organically. A story can grow in the telling without a fixed escalation schedule. Some memories can be accurate, some exaggerated, some deliberate lies and some honestly muddled. His existing beast/species knowledge remains governed by its current owner. That knowledge does not automatically authenticate every personal anecdote, claimed feat, remembered date or self-serving explanation.

He still has meals to enjoy, people to care about and immediate problems to address. Not every gathering becomes a dinosaur speech. The existing Jesus-age banter and contextual banjo freestyle remain independently available; this is not a requirement to combine all three bits. If he chooses an established stalking freestyle, the existing fresh Chris-directed-stray rule still governs that performance.

4.


EXACT CURRENT-SOURCE CONFLICT
The newest user direction supersedes that speech-restoration clause. Sovereign's other control, power, stamina, precision and body mechanics remain governed by their existing rules.

The permanent gamma mutation is baseline biology. It is not itself an active transformation for the purpose of this speech split.

PROPOSED ROUTING
Future active gamma branches: the same register when legitimately earned and active.

This voice rule does not create a new form, stack or transformation event.

NORSE KRATOS RESEARCH
Cory Barlog describes Kratos beginning to yell, catching his breath and forcing himself to explain. His fuller interview says the team calibrated between excessive cruelty and an excessively serene performance, partly through small wording and delivery changes. These are specific reasons to model active restraint and considered language. [K1, K2]

For Ragnarök, narrative director Matt Sophos says Kratos and Atreus have different goals and can each be right or wrong. This supports listening, reconsideration and relationship growth alongside firmness.

BASELINE APPLICATION
He can roast, talk shit, tell stories, participate in chaos, start trouble himself and complain while helping. Affection can be direct, practical or teasing. Slang, ordinary contractions and profanity remain available because they already belong .

The Kratos influence adds weight to decisions: direct verbs; complete, deliberate clauses; a question with an actual purpose; a warning delivered as a settled boundary; and emotion that is sometimes controlled before the next sentence. When real danger engages protector mode, he wastes fewer words. When company is safe, he still has room to talk.

He can acknowledge error without losing stature, explain a practical lesson without giving a sermon, and offer care without hiding it behind a joke every time. Humorous refusal or a flat observation can sharpen his existing comic range. No Kratos memories, godhood, family history, accent or actor identity is transferred.

RAGNAROK HULK RESEARCH
The archived Thor: Ragnarok screenplay contains short concrete clauses, frequent third-person reference, omitted grammatical connectors, repetition, refusal and teasing. It also contains first-person statements, past tense, contractions, complete sentences, apology and a polite request. Its dialogue sustains wounded feelings, friendship and reconciliation within that register. Thus a rigid rule that Hulk speech can never use 'I' or a full sentence would be less faithful to this reference. [H1]

The cast's press-conference testimony discusses the opportunity for actual conversation with Hulk and the value of grounding his relationship with Thor. Smart Hulk is a distinct later treatment; ILM calls the Endgame version a reinvention.

ALL-GAMMA APPLICATION
Use compact clauses, concrete nouns and direct verbs. never substitute the literal identity Hulk. Articles, copulas and auxiliaries can fall away, but the thought remains intelligible. A short fully grammatical phrase can coexist with the dominant reduced register. Avoid mechanical word deletion, a fixed word count, or the same grammar mistake in every sentence.

Maintain the register in calm conversation, practical coordination, humor, affection, wounded pride, apology, storytelling and anger. His profanity and affectionate insults remain available. Volume responds to the situation

His intelligence, memory, agency, relationships, vocabulary knowledge and trained combat continue under their existing rules. A form can change how he expresses a tactical idea without deleting the idea. A genuine condition-related impairment still follows its actual owner.

Control differences remain audible within the same register. Sovereign can wait, listen, choose exact targets, give clear sequences and modulate force and volume. These are contextual possibilities, not compulsory symptoms or a new personality per form. Sovereign keeps Hulk speech throughout its active state.

PROPOSED REPLACEMENT FOR THE SOVEREIGN CLAUSE
Greater control makes the delivery steadier and the thought more precise

Its controlled speech and personality are expressed through the active gamma Hulk register when the future form is legitimately unlocked and active.

5. USER-SELECTED CHANGE: CHRIS'S HEAVY THEO VON SPEECH INFLUENCE

User direction: Chris's speech should be heavily influenced by Theo Von, on top of what he already has.

KEEP THE EXISTING CHRIS
Chris remains the Milwaukee-born human chef, inventor, scavenger/hoarder and gunslinger with his established bond, modern profanity, abrasion, disgust, RDR2 fixation and capacity for patient technical work. Billy remains a separate consciousness and speaker. Neither receives the other's regional biography or the reference performer's life.

RESEARCH FINDINGS
In the original Milwaukee Comedy Q&A, Theo credits his home community as a source of his humor, and his answers vary between extended explanation and literal, compressed responses. This is useful evidence that the voice has more range than a continuous wandering anecdote. [T1]

The reproduced transcript of solo episode 173, Snow Day, develops immediate observations into connected absurd explanations, with restarts and qualifications. Its tangents often retain a relationship to the initial object. This is a reading of an actual performance in text, not a measured account of pitch or pause length. [T2]

In episode 535 with Joe Gatto, Theo discusses sometimes learning something while talking and sharing personal material beyond prepared jokes. Episode 272 also contains a sustained sincere response about burnout and self-care amid comedy and caller conversation. These support allowing apparent thought-in-progress and unembellished feeling. [T3, T4]

The latter three sources are third-party transcript reproductions, matched to the official episode titles/listings. Automatic-transcription errors remain. No claim is made that every anecdote is literal autobiography, or that the performer consciously uses the exact framework proposed below.

PROPOSED HEAVY-INFLUENCE APPLICATION

1. Let an observed detail start the thought.
Chris notices a smell, texture, stance, object, bad repair or social habit. His comparison should have an understandable connection to that observation, even when it becomes absurd. This supplies a recurrent way of thinking aloud rather than a detachable catchphrase.

2. Give the imagined explanation peculiar specificity.
The joke can concern the exact petty thing somebody looks capable of doing, or the future a discarded component seems to deserve. Use current observation and established memory. If he invents a person or comparison, make the hypothetical or comic framing clear; do not silently add a childhood neighbor, job or embarrassing past event to his biography.

3. Let him revise the thought while speaking.
A selective restart, qualification or self-correction can become the route to the joke. The revision should sharpen or change the idea. Constant filler, endless stammering and unfinished syntax would suppress his practical competence and burden TTS.

4. Allow him to defend the absurdity earnestly.
Chris may seem concerned about the implications of his own comparison, argue for an object he wants to keep or make an oddly sympathetic observation. Other characters need not agree or laugh. He can also abandon the thought when something more important happens.

5. Feed the associations through Chris's existing interests.
Cooking, seasoning, texture, heat, salvage, springs, optics, ugly useful machinery, maintenance, ammunition, shopping judgment, hoarding and RDR2 give this voice personal material. A tangential remark can end in a correct practical instruction. Do not force every line to contain both a kitchen metaphor and a game reference.

6. Keep the abrasive edge and allow tenderness.
He can be profane, confrontational and disgusted while sounding oddly sincere about a ridiculous comparison. When the issue is personal, he may make a practical offer, admit a feeling or stop elaborating. A joke need not erase the sincerity. This adds range; it does not overwrite his existing morally mixed priorities.

7. Let immediate danger make him exact.
His hands and judgment can already be doing serious work while he rambles. When a time-critical detail needs attention, he can reduce to a clear instruction. This is a proposed Chris application, not a factual claim about Theo's conduct in danger.

8. Make the influence recurrent without copying a performance.
Connected absurd comparisons, unusual specificity and thought-in-progress should be recognizable across Chris's ordinary speech, while room remains for plain talk, anger and silence. Preserve Chris's own vocabulary. Use original jokes and anecdotes rather than stock Theo catchphrases, copied routines or imported personal beliefs. No exact Louisiana accent has been selected for Chris.

ORIGINAL CHRIS VOICE CALIBRATIONS — NOT THEO QUOTES OR CANON EVENTS
- Chef, bad food: "That soup tastes like somebody rinsed a fucking tombstone in it. Move. Let me cook."
- Hoarder, defending salvage: "Throw it away? That's a spring with a future. Put him back in the fucking box."
- Inventor, observing a bad repair: "Somebody welded this like they were trying to get fired without losing their benefits."
- Strange social comparison: "Look at the way he's standing. That man hides his good cereal from his own family."
- Thought revised aloud: "It smells expensive in here. No—expensive and wet. Somebody's rich uncle drowned in this fucking carpet."
- RDR2 enthusiasm: "Arthur, you calling me an idiot in person is still a pretty big day for me."
- Plain affection: "Eat, man. You can be mad at me with some food in you."
- Immediate competence: "No, don't fucking touch it. The catch has been filed down. Let me look."

The comparisons describe Chris's impressions, not privileged knowledge about the target. They do not confirm a hidden family, corpse in a carpet, employment history or mechanical defect in any actual scene. The tools, observations and characters required by an example must exist before it can be used in PLAY.

SEPARATE THE NEW VOICES THROUGH WHAT THEY WANT
Billy's glory-days routine often seeks respect, attention, a captive conversational audience, or appreciation for his hospitality and old experience. Chris's associative speech often explores an observation, defends his judgment, values an object, criticizes something, or discovers a thought while speaking. Each can be funny without borrowing the others' default construction.

Later integration owner: canon/characters/chris_catfish_billy_current.md, Chris's identity/dialogue baseline and relevant chef/fabrication/RDR2 voice sections. The addition is for Chris, not a rewrite of Billy's separate speaker.


6. RESEARCH BASIS AND LIMITS

Completed work: preserved the prior Kaze/Vaas research; corrected the proposed Billy age and working hat choice; researched Southern speech, Uncle Rico, Norse Kratos, Ragnarok Hulk and Theo Von; drafted the new character applications and behavior brainstorm. No full QAPX, source cutover or PLAY performance has been executed.

Access truth:
- The new voice work uses regional linguistic scholarship, attested language, direct creator/performer interviews, an archived screenplay and episode transcript reproductions. Specific access and source limitations appear in the additional ledger below.
- Every newly written character example is original calibration material, not a quotation from the reference performer or a delivered story event.
- Inspected official Ubisoft text, its Michael Mando podcast transcript (including a primary game-dialogue excerpt), Prima's Ubisoft-assisted dossier, and original published creator/performer interviews.
- Official video references were located, but usable audiovisual playback and captions were not obtained. One official Ubisoft player exposed caption metadata; the caption fetch returned zero bytes. No footage was watched or audio measured.
- Consequently, exact accent classification, pitch, vocal rasp, breath placement, gesture timing, pause duration, mannerism frequency, and a full scene-by-scene performance audit remain unverified.
- The guide's design and biography statements, direct creator testimony, close reading of the accessible excerpt, and original Kaze application have been identified separately.
- Far Cry Experience, Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 6: Vaas: Insanity are distinct reference scopes. No later dream mechanics or character history has been transferred to Kaze.
- The original Dan Hay interview is hosted on an interviewer's user blog. Its provenance is stated by that interviewer; it is supporting evidence and is not represented as an official Ubisoft publication. The principal intention/volatility finding is independently grounded in Prima and Purdy.
- The Unfinished Man page displays a later publication date than its pre-release interview wording implies. This addendum does not use that displayed date to date the interview.
- Deep research does not certify the acting quality of future unwritten episodes. The proposed Kaze interpretation remains staged for the author's review and later authorized integration.

  meaning: Hat-aperture observation does not pass hands, weapons, objects, salvage or ammunition.
- id: FLESHLIGHT_AUDIO_CAPTURE
  value: false
  meaning: The local FLESHLIGHT live video, replay and saved clips contain images only; no new exterior microphone,
    audio track or inbound-audio route.
- id: FLESHLIGHT_REPLAY_WORLD_CONTROL
  value: false
  meaning: Local pause/replay controls do not pause, rewind, restore or control exterior events, Billy, swallowing

- id: FLESHLIGHT_RECOIL_SUPPORT
  value: false
  meaning: THE FLESHLIGHT cannot brace THE CRITIC or route recoil.
- id: FLESHLIGHT_OUTSIDER_VIEW_IN
  value: false
  meaning: Outsiders cannot look through Billy hat aperture into BELLY OF THE BILLY.

  meaning: Banjo is outward audio, not a matter channel.
  value: false
timed bark may serve roast-relay response.
- id: BLACKLIGHT_SOUL_DISGUISE
  value: false
  meaning: Biological disguise does not copy unique soul/divine/conceptual identity or authority.
- id: PROJECT_PRESENTATION_OWNS_CAUSALITY
  value: false
  meaning: Presentation follows resolution and cannot choose outcomes.
- id: COUNT_HIGH_NOON_SIMULTANEOUS_DUPLICATES
  value: false
  meaning: HIGH NOON and THE COUNT are two states of one transforming primary platform, not independent simultaneous
    primaries.
- id: COUNT_ALLSPARK_CONSCIOUSNESS
  value: false
  meaning: AllSpark contribution supplies machine-life reflex/adaptive coordination only; THE COUNT and Arthur cybernetics
    do not gain an independent mind.
- id: TEEMO_CRITIC_JARVIS_AI
  value: false
  meaning: Current Teemo-in-THE-CRITIC is Teemo soul-consciousness bound to the rifle, not AI/JARVIS/aimbot/omniscient
    computer.
- id: CATFISH_CURRENT_SELF_ESCAPE_PRELOAD
  value: false
  meaning: Billy-controlled release/regurgitation is the only currently established BELLY OF THE BILLY exit; future
    Penitentiary breakout mechanism stays unresolved until earned.
- id: ARTHUR_PREBLAST_CYBER_PRELOAD
  value: false
  meaning: Historical pre-blast scenes still cannot preload Cyber-Arthur. At the current Second Temporal Relaunch
    pilot opening, Cyber-Arthur, UNSHAKEN, HIGH NOON/THE COUNT and AllSpark/IDC Power Stone integration are carried
    earned state.
- id: KAZE_NARUTO_OCULAR_PACKAGE
  value: false
  meaning: Old Kamui/Kokugan remains retired; s29 right Eternal Mangekyō/left Six-Tomoe replacement is current.
    Images cannot override it.
- id: MINI_BILLY_STABLE_COEXISTENCE
  value: false
  meaning: No mini-Billy exists in current execution; inside-out switching preserves one exterior body and the inactive
    full-size partner inside.
- id: CHRIS_BILLY_EXTERIOR_STATE_INERTIA
  value: false
  meaning: Chris or Billy being the current exterior state does not itself justify keeping that state; the owner
    resolves switching from actual motive, utility, timing and agency with no quota.
- id: RAPID_BOND_SWITCH_INVULNERABILITY
  value: false
  meaning: The rapid bond switch is near-instant but grants no teleportation, phasing, invulnerability frames, automatic
    restraint escape, injury reset or position reset.
- id: UNCLE_RUCKUS_ACTIVE_NARRATOR
  value: false
  meaning: Uncle Ruckus removed. Black Mimir ordinary narrator; only specifically authorized brief S3 Deadpool hijack
    is allowed.
- id: PRESENTATION_CHANGES_RESOLVED_CAUSALITY
  value: false
  meaning: Presentation CRFA may change disclosure and style only; it cannot rewrite resolved events, chronology,
    actor choice, mechanics, injuries, deaths, resources, knowledge or consequence.
- id: OFFSCREEN_MEANS_PAUSED
  value: false
  meaning: Materially active actors/factions continue from their own motives off-camera; tiered simulation is a
    performance strategy, not a pause.
- id: BIG_NAME_SURVIVAL_OR_DURATION_PROTECTION
  value: false
  meaning: Fame itself grants nothing. Explicit S37 named authoring survival constraints control setup selection;
    never invent immunity or erase valid outcomes.
- id: NARRATOR_STORY_STRUCTURE_AWARENESS
  value: false
  meaning: Black Mimir may derail emotionally but never narrates episode/plot/story construction as in-world fact.
- id: SWALLOWED_EXPLOSIVE_PROPAGATION
  value: false
  meaning: Explosions after legitimate Billy intake do not injure Billy or BELLY OF THE BILLY occupants; this does
    not universalize to exotic nonphysical effects.
- id: PENITENTIARY_FUTURE_SEASON_FORESHADOW
  value: false
  meaning: CATFISH PENITENTIARY may grow visibly in Season Two, but narration never advertises a future-season payoff.
- id: KAZE_BASELINE_VISIBLE_BLACK_MARROW
  value: false
  meaning: Black Marrow is not visibly carried at baseline; Kaze manifests it from/reintegrates it into his body.
- id: OMEGA_TEEMO_PRELOAD_BEFORE_MASK_TEST
  value: false
  meaning: Current Teemo stays post-ASU and Critic-only until the future on-screen first completed Predator-mask
    test triggers the Omega transition.
- id: PREDATOR_MASK_FULL_SUITE_PRETEST
  value: false
  meaning: Mask is not yet transferred/integrated at reboot root; full suite requires actual engineering/testing.
- id: ARTHUR_CHRIS_LINK_REMOTE_CONTROL
  value: false
  meaning: Cross-dimensional link shares information/calls only; it never grants remote body, weapon, aim or Dead
    Eye control.
- id: KAZE_BLACKLIGHT_EXTRA_WEAPON_MORPHS
  value: false
  meaning: No new BLACKLIGHT weapon morphs beyond Black Marrow; no stretching/tendril combat substitute.
source_layers:
  PROJECT: hot execution runtime and controlling active owners
  NOTION: control plane / staged and committed decisions / source map / relations; not mutable-state authority
  GOOGLE_DRIVE: deep archive / originals / large files / backups / old cutovers / cold evidence
  GITHUB: versioning / diffs / rollback / validator and compiler scripts / automated tests
  READWISE: optional external research intake/highlights; never canon by storage alone
  status: Architectural roles only. No external service is required or certified installed; all controlling owners
    are in the clean manifest. Optional archives/tools never outrank those owners.

retrieval_contract:
  bootstrap:
  - manifest
  - runtime
  - current_state
  - hot_runtime_if_hash_AND_projection_match
  - execution_index
  load_policy: Use the selected boundary and requested material recipe. Load only source pointers, region/event
    route and decision-relevant records. Expand complete material closure; regional membership alone never loads
    every champion. Full owner packets remain fallback when a narrow recipe is insufficient.
  material_packet_fields:
  - packet_id
  - base_checkpoint
  - task
  - seed_entities
  - seed_domains
  - required_modules
  - required_state_paths
  - required_event_refs
  - required_unknown_refs
  - required_visual_refs
  - unclosed_dependencies
  - closure_status
  dependency_edges:
  - REQUIRES
  - CAUSED_BY
  - LEARNED_FROM
  - SUPERSEDES
  - CONTRADICTS
  - DEPENDS_ON
  - KNOWN_BY
  - BELIEVED_BY
  - WITNESSED_BY
  - HIDDEN_FROM
  - ENABLES
  - DISABLES
  - MODIFIES
  - PROHIBITS
  - UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENT
  - PROVENANCE_SUPPLIED_BY
  fail_closed: true
  ordinary_play_metadata:
  - state/HOT_RUNTIME.yaml#/selected_playback_state
  - EXECUTION_INDEX.yaml#material_closure_contract
  demand_load:
    event/roster.yaml: exact identity/snapshot/group/scope ambiguity
    state/accepted_events.jsonl: exact recovery/replay/transaction
    derived/STATE_VIEWS.yaml: knowledge/resource/custody/obligation dependency
    derived/JOURNAL_INDEX.yaml: transaction lookup
    derived/OWNER_SECTIONS.yaml: bounded owner excerpts with complete material closure
    reference/runeterra/core.md: regional ecology, source reconciliation, branch overlays and cross-region carriers
    reference/runeterra/key_profiles.md: twin-city full standardized entity fields or detailed key voices
    reference/runeterra/champion_appendix.md: remaining full regional entity fields

  one_canonical_definition_per_mechanic: true
  capability_separate_from_availability: true
  unknown_stays_unknown: true
  physical_file_consolidation_may_bundle_logical_owners: true
  one_canonical_definition_per_rule: true
  stable_rule_ids: true
  derived_views_non_authoritative: true
  causal_retrieval_over_keyword_only: true
  current_state_sole_mutable_authority: true
  hot_runtime_derived_only: true
  physical_consolidation_preserves_logical_owners: true
  performance_optimization_never_reduces_simulation_depth: true

    any derived view; correct hashes alone do not prove projection contents.

    visual text are history, never supporting current authority; mechanics remain scoped to text.

  physical_and_logical_separation: true
  cold_evidence_role: History/recovery only; historical statuses cannot reactivate old rules
  optional_missing_details: Block dependent use, not the whole project

    frontier.

reliability_contracts:
  authority: routing/schema only
  projection_contract: Every derived view declares source dependencies, projection recipe and content hash. Exact
    source content must match, not hashes alone. Runtime rejects dependency or projection drift.
  view_validator: audit companion compile_views.py / validate_qapx.py; executable helpers are QA artifacts, declarative
    owner contracts remain in clean set
  delivery_evidence: verified complete output vs partial/unsent plan; no twice-counted delivery
  no_play_in_qa: true

  mode: READ_ONLY_OWNER_CLOSURE

        removed.

      owners:
      - state/current_state.yaml
      - reference/runeterra/core.md
      - reference/runeterra/key_profiles.md
      - reference/runeterra/champion_appendix.md

      - event/roster.yaml
      - reference/imported_snapshot_fidelity.md
      - reference/research/Crossover_Fidelity_Audit.md
      - reference/research/Season2_Cast_Fidelity_Audit.md
      rule: exact snapshot, independent motives, material tools, recognition limits
    act_delivery:
      owners:
      - state/current_state.yaml
      - event/objectives.yaml
      - canon/presentation/PRESENTATION.md
      - reference/runeterra/core.md
      - event/season23_blueprint.md
      - canon/characters/s37_kit_application.md

      owners:
      - canon/characters/chris_catfish_billy_current.md
      - canon/characters/chris_catfish_billy_future.md
      - state/current_state.yaml
      - event/objectives.yaml
      - canon/presentation/PRESENTATION.md
      - visuals/visual_manifest.yaml

        identity and current sole visual. Old design gates are historical; no duplicated evolution or ignorance
        reset.'
    group_decision:
      owners:
      - canon/characters/global_originals.md
      - canon/characters/kaze_psychology.md
      - canon/characters/chris_catfish_billy_current.md
      - canon/characters/daniel.md
      - canon/characters/other_originals.md

        shared morality or role lock.

      - state/current_state.yaml

      - canon/characters/chris_catfish_billy_future.md
      - canon/presentation/PRESENTATION.md

        switch orientation; no new story during WORK.

    WARM: supported near-term plans
    COOL: ongoing delayed consequences
    DORMANT: stable until evidence-supported wake, not frozen
