# DANIEL — JOKE-SPECIAL DELIVERY / BEHAVIOR OWNER

Source family SRC-01; subordinate to `daniel.md` for mechanics, physiology and current availability. Shared narrator/relay rules are in `canon/presentation/group_roast_relay.md`. This is a retained repertoire of user-approved joke opportunities, not an episode checklist, a compelled reaction, new target anatomy or new powers.

## Mandatory joke-special rule

**Every deliberate use of a Daniel special built around a dad joke/pun/corny name receives either its spoken name or a clearly connected dad joke from Daniel.** The delivery may precede, accompany or immediately follow the actual action. Repetition of the exact words is optional unless an exact signature bit is specified below. Ordinary punches, every Byakugan tap, individual chain links, every transformation and generic martial movements do not each require a shouted label.

One named multi-hit special needs one associated payoff, not a line per hit. Another deliberate use of the special needs another payoff. Physics continues: he can be interrupted, cannot speak while his mouth is occupied without a real opportunity, and cannot extend an unwinnable pause to deliver comedy. Completing a cut-off punchline at the next supported opportunity is a callback, not a retroactive time stop. Blackout Daniel can deliver ingrained routines but will not remember the episode afterward.

Humor can be friendly/corny, absurd, childish, profane, raunchy, grotesque, morbid, bleak, offensive, cruel or intentionally tasteless according to target, mood, circumstances and Daniel's choice. Serious stakes do not force family-friendly jokes or silence him. Nor must every line be maximally offensive. Joke tone does not establish truth, private knowledge, anatomy, target guilt, target laughter or a successful attack. Source-faithful personalities may respond, ignore him or act through it.

## SEE FOOD — exact anchor

**“you like sea food?” → actual vomit at the opponent → “get it?? SEE FOOD”**

Case/punctuation may be voiced naturally, but retain the explicit sea/see-food setup and payoff rather than replacing it with generic barf banter. Daniel may then freeze the expelled material and use the opening. The exact target and timing remain physical. This deliberately authored dad-joke special is **not** permission to engineer a separate `no diddy` opening; the latter must arise accidentally from an otherwise legitimate scene.

## Approved frozen-puke family

- **Frozen Spew:** expelled liquid flash-freezes in flight or on contact.
- **Puke Glacier:** larger actual spread becomes an icy ground hazard.
- **Brain Freeze:** frozen-puke-to-head variant; same intentionally reused name as Daniel's cryo head-strike family.
- **On the Rocks:** puke/freeze plus physical punishment; intentionally shares a name with his terrain-slam/freezing family.
- **Cold Lunch:** quick frozen-puke projectile.
- **Freeze & Eject:** gross setup becomes a real frozen obstruction/trap.
- **Blizzard Barf:** wider spray with cold mist/frost.
- **Black-Ice Barf:** stronger dark-ice material requires the earned Black-Ice state.

All require actual delivery and available cold; no inherent poison, corrosiveness, infinite volume, guaranteed disgust, guaranteed binding or unconscious execution. Comedy, humiliation and severe damage can coexist when supported. Cold cannot be added to every listed phrase merely because the name contains ice.

## Approved joke bank — keep the relationship between setup and actual action

The quoted lines are usable original examples/anchors, not mandatory canned wording except SEE FOOD. Multiple aliases can refer to the same mechanics; different moves can share an intentional bad name. **LAST CALL was Chris's now-retired project name, not a Daniel technique; LAST ROUND is distinct and remains valid.**

| Label / phrase family | Physical or conversational opportunity |
|---|---|
| ICE TO MEET YOU / FROST IMPRESSION | Cold contact or introduction: “Ice to meet you.” / first–frost impression wordplay. |
| CHILL OUT / COOL IT / COOL OFF | Interrupt a real attack or cool an actual target; do not freeze anger itself. |
| FREEZE FRAME | Leave an established ice shell during a valid clone transfer. |
| BREAK THE ICE / ICE BREAKER | Break out of or shatter a clone, or a valid spear breakthrough; Daniel can insist these are different jokes. |
| COLD SHOULDER | Reinforced shoulder check: “Don't take it personal. Cold shoulder.” |
| BRAIN FREEZE | Precision head/upper-body cold strike or the separate frozen-spew use. |
| ON THE ROCKS | Actual terrain slam/freezing or spew/freeze follow-up. |
| NEAT | A very hard plain punch with no ice gimmick: “I like mine neat.” |
| DOUBLE SHOT | Two real precision strikes: “Make it a double.” |
| LAST ROUND / HAPPY HOUR | A final chosen exchange or sudden combination; not a compelled final kill. |
| OPEN BAR / BOTTOMLESS | Ice-weapon options or the refilling bottle, depending on context; no unbounded industrial output inferred. |
| BOTTOMS UP / STRAIGHT UP | Rising attack, real launch or drinking. |
| SHAKEN, NOT— | Start a familiar drink-style setup, lose the wording, commit to a rotational move anyway. |
| COLD ONE / ANOTHER COLD ONE | Create an ice weapon, then another; repetition can be Daniel's deliberate bad humor. |
| PROOF / HIGH PROOF | Demonstrate actual control/output; doubles with the PROOF mastery label but drinking more grants no level. |
| LIQUOR? I HARDLY KNOW HER | Raunchy forced pun when liquor is already relevant; not compelled flirtation or a romance subplot. |
| BAR TAB / CLOSE YOUR TAB | A real chain bind and follow-through; no automatic debt/killing contract. |
| HOUSE SPECIAL / HOUSE ON THE ROCKS | An existing improvisational ice option or freezing established nearby structures. |
| SLIPPERY WHEN WET / WATCH YOUR STEP | A real wet/icy surface and an actual slip or warning; no fake result. |
| SEE FOOD | Exact signature bit above; optional freeze follows. |
| FROZEN LEFTOVERS / COLD LUNCH / BRAIN FOOD | Existing expelled matter, frozen food/puke and the high-target variant. |
| FREEZE & EJECT / RETURN TO SENDER | Real ejection/freezing sequence; the phrase does not reflect an incoming attack automatically. |
| PUKE GLACIER | “Global warming ain't fixing that shit” as a character joke, not a world-climate assertion. |
| BLIZZARD BARF / SCATTERED SHOWERS | Disgusting spray and local cold weather language. |
| BLACK-ICE BARF | Earned black-ice hazard with a late warning or icy-road joke. |
| SNOW PROBLEM / SNOW WAY / SNOW JOKE | Cold solution, valid escape or severe ice result. |
| FROST BITE | Actual biting/contact cold or an existing ice-claw/jaw-like shape; no new living companion or full transformation by pun. |
| COLD HARD FACTS / COLD HARD CASH | Heavy ice-arm hit or money talk; the joke does not transmute ice into currency. |
| MONKEY BUSINESS / QUIT MONKEYING AROUND | Simian parkour/mischief; announcing an end to it while doing more can be the joke. |
| APE SHIT / GO BANANAS | Deliberate violent simian/Saiyan escalation; not a separate form or mandatory rage state. |
| HANG IN THERE | Daniel hanging upside down or a target actually suspended by a valid restraint. |
| BRANCH MANAGER / ASSISTANT BRANCH MANAGER | A real perch/branch/beam; a friend can reject the assigned title. |
| SPEAR ME THE DETAILS / SPEAR ME | Spear/spare wordplay during an actual explanation or plea; deliberate cruel mishearing possible. |
| GET THE POINT? / THAT'S MY POINT / POINT TAKEN | Real spear exchanges and follow-up tags, including Daniel admitting an opponent's counter landed. |
| CHAIN REACTION / OFF THE CHAIN / WEAK LINK | Changing chain geometry, flexible-weapon escalation or an observed structural flaw. |
| HOLD THAT THOUGHT / TIED UP | Actual restraint, not speech magically immobilizing someone. |
| FOOTLOOSE / TOE-TALLY / KICKING IT / BEST FOOT FORWARD | Real foot-held weapon grip, kicks or breakdance manipulation. |
| FOOT IN YOUR MOUTH / TWO LEFT FEET | Foot attack or observed awkward movement; no automatic anatomical alteration. |
| HEAD OVER HEELS / FALLING FOR ME | Actual headscissors, rotational throw or fake fall. |
| TRIP ADVISOR / BREAKING NEWS / BREAK A LEG | Actual trip/breakdance impact/leg attack, not guarantees that injuries occur. |
| SPIN DOCTOR / ROUNDABOUT / SCENIC ROUTE | Real body orbit/rotation. |
| FLIP SIDE / FLIP OUT / FLOOR ROUTINE / TURNAROUND | Flips, floorwork and supported target switches. |
| SNAP DECISION / SPLITTING HEADACHE | Abrupt decision/strike or legitimate high hit; word choice alone does not break a joint. |
| PALM READING / I SEE YOUR POINTS | Actual palm/Byakugan observation; no automatic mind-reading. |
| EYE SEE WHAT YOU DID THERE / KEEP AN EYE OUT / TWENTY-TWENTY / BLIND DATE | Perception jokes, not new ocular powers or global blindness. |
| SNOWBALL EFFECT / ICEOLATED / UN-BRRR-LIEVABLE / COOL STORY, BRO | Existing cascading conditions, actual ice separation, terrible cold pun or interruption. |
| DEAD SERIOUS / KILLING ME / DROP-DEAD FUNNY / TOUGH CROWD | Morbid remarks around genuine threat/death; not a kill requirement. |
| CUT IT OUT / NEED A HAND? | Actual blade/limb context, including grotesque interpretation. |
| CLONE DEATH FAKE-OUT | “You killed me. Anyway.” after an opponent actually destroys a decoy and Daniel is alive elsewhere. |
| CLONE INSURANCE FRAUD | “That one was insured.” is a joke, not an established insurance company or contract. |
| UNCLE BUSINESS | Family roast toward myth Sun Wukong. A boast is attributed Daniel dialogue, not proof of unestablished training history. |
| MONKEY SEE… MONKEY DO / MONKEY DID IT BETTER | Successful compatible imitation/adaptation; actual success must precede boasting as fact. |
| GOOD SPIRITS / POUR DECISIONS | Liquor/poor-choice wordplay; no return of ghost mechanics. |
| SHOT TO THE LIVER | Hypocritical drinking advice around a real anatomically valid target. |
| GLASS HALF FULL / SHATTERED EXPECTATIONS | Breakable bottle or construct damage; not inconsistent with later indestructibility. |
| TIP THE GLASSBLOWER | Callback only after Chris actually completes Daniel's bottle upgrade. |
| BOTTLE SERVICE / HOLD MY DRINK | Real handoff to someone actually present, with custody retained. |

## Delivery and reciprocal behavior

**Setup recognition:** words, current poses, injuries, objects, gear, existing names and environmental details can create a pun. He can ask a leading question, bait a correction, deliberately mishear, or make the joke physically literal using an already available ability. Opponents do not have to answer. Visual/private/source information he lacks cannot become a targeted roast.

**Escalation:** if a line flops, Daniel can explain it, ask “you get it?”, explain it twice after someone says yes, try a related pun, or invent a worse recovery. An annoyed groan can satisfy him. Sometimes he laughs before the punchline; sometimes dead-serious delivery makes it worse. He does not require audience validation.

**Reciprocity:** friends can steal the punchline, feed a setup, destroy him verbally, or outdo the physical bit. He can laugh, admire the comeback, then compete. An opponent who laughs may gain momentary social regard without automatic mercy. no forced Daniel voice. Genuine roast relays use the separate rotating GET EM! rule.

**Distractibility:** a miniature story can wander into unrelated details, absorb an ongoing fight into its punchline, lose its original point, or end in nodding out. He can remember a cut-off joke later, improvise a bad substitute, wake and finish it if memory permits, or forget the punchline altogether. That is an option, not a repetitive prescribed scene sequence or excuse to pad a part.

**Blackout recurrence:** habitual joke delivery may survive an alcohol blackout but later event memory does not. Being told his own line can make him laugh as though hearing it for the first time. An independently repeated line can recur without magically recovering the earlier scene. Named-move drift is allowed; Brain Freeze/On the Rocks deliberately have multiple physical uses.

**Darkness and bad timing:** jokes may involve blood, corpses, missing limbs, funerals, burial, final words, smells, raunchy anatomical wordplay or bleak observations when a real setup exists. These are character choices, not objective diagnosis or a demand for maximal cruelty every time. Seriousness does not automatically sanitize Daniel. Emotional stakes, current actions and consequences still belong to the characters.

**Mischief and feints:** knowledgeable friends/opponents may recognize his setup as a tell. Daniel can bait that expectation with an alternate valid attack and corresponding joke. A failed feint remains failed. The punchline cannot stop time, finish the action for him, rewrite damage, or compel a listener's reaction.

The core is **notice a setup → commit to the bit → sometimes make it physically literal → accept/compete with the reaction → keep acting**. Repeated use preserves history while varying circumstance, timing, meaning and consequence; no copy-paste episode routine.
